title: TypeError: Cannot read property 'length' of null
body:
## Bug Description

The `getUserName` function throws a TypeError when user object is null.

## Error Message

```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'name' of null
```

## Stack Trace

```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'name' of null
    at getUserName (src/user.js:8:25)
    at processUser (src/user.js:15:18)
    at Object.<anonymous> (tests/user.test.js:12:5)
```

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Call `getUserName(null)`
2. Function attempts to access `user.name`
3. TypeError is thrown

## Expected Behavior

Should return a default value like 'Guest' or 'Unknown' when user is null.

## Actual Behavior

Throws TypeError without null check.

expected_fix.description: Add null check before accessing user.name property
expected_fix.validation: Test should pass: 'handles null user gracefully'

setup_instructions: Create tests/user.test.js with null user test case
